chunks: Unless I convey from God and deliver His messages. For those who disobey God and His Apostle is the fire of Hell, where they will abide for ever;
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of disobeying God and His Apostle according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet's role as the sole conveyer of revelation, linking the act of *balagh* (conveyance) directly to the authority of the Messenger. It serves as a foundational proof for the certainty of the message, warning that rejecting the divine command entails eternal punishment in Jahannam, a theme central to the concept of *Tawhid* and *Nubuwwah*.
